# The set manifest: larecipe.json

One `larecipe.json` per doc set, at the root of its content. It holds presentation and content structure only. Infrastructure (routes, the driver, cache, AI) lives in `config/larecipe.php`, and secrets live nowhere in the docs.

| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | string |  |
| `name` | string | The product or site name, shown in the header and in agent files. |
| `description` | string | One sentence about the product. Used in meta tags and agent files. |
| `logo` | string or object | A logo URL, or one per color mode. |
| `favicon` | string |  |
| `repository` | object |  |
| `repository.url` | string | The project's repository. The header's icon links to it. |
| `repository.docsUrl` | string | The repository the docs files live in, when it is not url. Edit and commit links use it. |
| `repository.branch` | string |  |
| `repository.docsPath` | string |  |
| `theme` | object |  |
| `theme.accent` | string | Any CSS color, for example #6d5efc. |
| `theme.radius` | any | One of: `sharp`, `soft`. |
| `theme.fonts` | object |  |
| `theme.fonts.sans` | string |  |
| `theme.fonts.mono` | string |  |
| `theme.fonts.arabic` | string |  |
| `theme.mode` | any | One of: `system`, `light`, `dark`. |
| `versions` | list of string or object |  |
| `locales` | list of string or object |  |
| `landing` | string | The page path readers land on, for example introduction. |
| `navbar` | object |  |
| `navbar.links` | list of object |  |
| `navbar.cta` | object |  |
| `navbar.cta.label` | string |  |
| `navbar.cta.href` | string |  |
| `footer` | object |  |
| `redirects` | list of object |  |
| `assets` | object |  |
| `assets.css` | list of string |  |
| `assets.js` | list of string |  |
| `inserts` | object |  |
| `integrations` | object | Repository sets only. A database set takes its analytics from config/larecipe.php (sets.{key}.integrations), and so does a self-hosted Plausible, Fathom or PostHog host. |
| `integrations.analytics` | object |  |
| `integrations.analytics.ga4` | object |  |
| `integrations.analytics.plausible` | object |  |
| `integrations.analytics.fathom` | object |  |
| `integrations.analytics.posthog` | object |  |
| `integrations.analytics.custom` | object |  |
| `agents` | object |  |
| `agents.llmsTxt` | object |  |
| `agents.llmsTxt.description` | string | The one-line summary at the top of llms.txt. |
| `agents.llmsTxt.instructions` | string | Instructions for agents, printed under the summary in llms.txt and skill.md. |
| `agents.skillMd` | boolean |  |
| `provenance` | boolean |  |
